title: Speed-to-Lead
summary: New lead → qualified, enriched, first-touched and booked in under 5 minutes, 24/7.

trigger.description: New lead lands in the CRM, a form, or the inbox.

agents.name: qualifier
agents.role: Scores the lead against the client's ICP; routes disqualified leads to a nurture list with a reason.

agents.name: enricher
agents.role: Pulls firmographics and context (site, role, company size) and writes an enrichment note to the CRM.

agents.name: first-responder
agents.role: Drafts the first-touch reply in the client's voice, referencing the lead's actual context.

agents.name: scheduler
agents.role: Proposes meeting slots and books the call once the lead replies.

rollback: Disable the crm.lead.created trigger; queued leads drain to the human inbox with full context notes. No data is deleted.
